name: Spicy Garlic-Miso Steak Bites with Pepper & Onion Cauliflower Rice

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with miso paste, soy sauce, sugar, and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
¼ cup miso paste, red
2 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the steak dry with paper towels, then cut into 1-inch cubes. Add to the bowl with the marinade, stir to coat, and set aside.
Wash and dry bell peppers. Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and medium dice. Place in another medium bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.

Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook, stirring occasionally, until desired doneness, 4-5 minutes for medium. Transfer to a plate, cover with aluminum foil, and set aside. (Reserve pot with drippings for the next step.)

Return pot (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, green onions, and cauliflower; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
3 (340 g) bags frozen, riced cauliflower

instructions.primary_message: When the cauliflower rice is done, remove from heat, add additional soy sauce, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and steak bites between plates. Enjoy!
